> 3. In **⚙ Settings**, change **Text size** to **Large**, Save — titles, descriptions, notes and tags all grow for easier reading; **Small** tightens them. Your choice is remembered on reload.

A few things to confirm:

- Do **Small / Medium / Large** text sizes and **10 / 25 / 50 / All** per-page choices cover what you need, or did you have finer control in mind?
- Is **classic Previous/Next paging** the right approach, or would you prefer **"Load more"** (appending) or continuous infinite scroll?
